## Review checklist

### Product and UX

- [ ] The change solves the stated problem.
- [ ] Mobile and field usability were considered.
- [ ] Loading, empty, error, and success states are handled where relevant.
- [ ] The approved design direction is preserved.

### Engineering

- [ ] The branch contains one task only.
- [ ] No unrelated rewrite or formatting churn is included.
- [ ] Business logic is testable and not unnecessarily duplicated.
- [ ] Dependencies are justified.

### Security and data

- [ ] Authorization is enforced beyond the UI.
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data were committed.
- [ ] Supabase schema changes use migrations.
- [ ] RLS and tenant boundaries were considered.

### Quality

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated.
- [ ] The final diff was reviewed.
- [ ] Documentation was updated.
